authority: 2026-09-10 owner requested a complete beam/model data audit, ETABS versus user ownership, and verification that editable Excel assumptions are used without repeated demo questions.
objective: Trace current input consumers and document a complete, stage-dependent data contract and demo-default resolution plan without changing engineering or installed applications.
bounded_units: Read current acquisition, workbook and engineering contracts
Trace assumptions/defaults through baseline request and freshness consumers
Update the existing workflow, task handoff and source-bound audit receipt
Freeze documentation, validate, independently audit and deliver one documentation PR

acceptance_rows.outcome: ETABS, user/preset and derived data are mapped to intake, topology, strength, serviceability, detailing, quantities, optimization, reanalysis and reports, including missing/unsupported states.
State actual Assumptions versus Design Inputs wiring, duplicate catalogue defaults, edit invalidation and current constraints with exact source evidence; do not claim unimplemented propagation.
Define persistent editable demo defaults, scoped overrides, immutable source facts, conflict handling and revision-driven reruns; retain code equations and qualified limits in the kernel.
Specify implementation priorities and measurable acceptance including two models, case roles, units, fire requirement and stale-result behavior; planned coverage is not implemented support.
No source code, preset values, installed workbook/add-in or ETABS model is changed; documentation/session checks and required hosted gates pass on the exact candidate.

non_goals: Implement or install a defaults resolver
Change required fire, seismic, solver or engineering support limits to make a demo pass
Read or mutate live ETABS/Excel state
Run analysis/design, publish a release or delete existing worktrees
likely_pitfalls: Confusing stale-result detection with propagation of changed values
Calling a preset field implemented because it exists in JSON
Inventing model loads, strengths, supports or SLS combinations from demo defaults
Treating required numerical/code limits as editable preferences
Requesting every possible future field before a supported operation can begin

focused: Static call-chain and contract inspection, no new tests during review
verification.runtime: No live application or new engineering qualification claimed.
